title: Results file of the benchmark kit
description: One row per reported number (docs/BENCHMARKS.md, 'The results-row contract'). A row names its model, its date, its sample size n, its metric, its value and a confidence interval [low, high]; a row that compares with another system names that system and publishes both configurations. tools/lint-claims holds a results file to the same contract and adds the two checks a JSON Schema cannot state: low is not above high, and the configuration of the other system is keyed by the name in `system`. `tools/bench --dry-run` checks that this schema accepts each of its own examples.

model.description: the model id as the provider served it, or the name of a model-free condition

date.description: the calendar day of the run, YYYY-MM-DD

n.description: the sample size behind the value

metric.description: what was measured, for example recall@10 or citation precision

ci.description: the confidence interval [low, high] of the value

system.description: the system the row measures; absent or agentic-system-core for this one

cited_unit_ids.description: the chunk ids an answer cited

gold_unit_ids.description: the gold chunk ids of the question

configs.description: one configuration per system, each an object with at least one member
